import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import SGDClassifier, LogisticRegression
from sklearn.ensemble import (
    GradientBoostingClassifier,
    HistGradientBoostingClassifier,
    RandomForestClassifier,
)
from sklearn.isotonic import IsotonicRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import warnings
import time

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
os.environ["TF_CPP_MIN_LOG_LEVEL"] = "3"
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_path = "./input/train.csv"
test_path = "./input/test.csv"
sample_path = "./input/sample_submission_null.csv"

train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(sample_path)

print(f"Training data loaded: {len(train_df)} rows")
print(f"Test data loaded: {len(test_df)} rows")


def preprocess_comment(text):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        text = str(text)
    text = text.replace("\\n", "\n")
    text = text.replace("\\xa0", "\xa0")
    text = text.replace("\\r", "\r")
    text = text.replace('\\"', '"')
    text = text.replace('"', '""')
    text = text.strip('"')
    text = text.strip()
    return text


train_df["Comment_Clean"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(preprocess_comment)
test_df["Comment_Clean"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(preprocess_comment)

all_train_texts = train_df["Comment_Clean"].values
all_train_labels = train_df["Insult"].values

train_indices, temp_indices = train_test_split(
    range(len(all_train_labels)),
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=all_train_labels,
)
val_indices, cal_indices = train_test_split(
    temp_indices,
    test_size=0.5,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=all_train_labels[temp_indices],
)

train_texts = all_train_texts[train_indices]
val_texts = all_train_texts[val_indices]
cal_texts = all_train_texts[cal_indices]
train_labels = all_train_labels[train_indices]
val_labels = all_train_labels[val_indices]
cal_labels = all_train_labels[cal_indices]

vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    max_features=50000,
    min_df=2,
    stop_words="english",
    lowercase=True,
    sublinear_tf=True,  # Improved atomic change: dampen high-frequency terms
)
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char", ngram_range=(2, 4), max_features=30000, min_df=1, lowercase=True
)

train_word_features = vectorizer.fit_transform(train_texts)
val_word_features = vectorizer.transform(val_texts)
cal_word_features = vectorizer.transform(cal_texts)
test_word_features = vectorizer.transform(test_df["Comment_Clean"].values)

train_char_features = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_texts)
val_char_features = char_vectorizer.transform(val_texts)
cal_char_features = char_vectorizer.transform(cal_texts)
test_char_features = char_vectorizer.transform(test_df["Comment_Clean"].values)

X_train = np.hstack([train_word_features.toarray(), train_char_features.toarray()])
X_val = np.hstack([val_word_features.toarray(), val_char_features.toarray()])
X_cal = np.hstack([cal_word_features.toarray(), cal_char_features.toarray()])
X_test = np.hstack([test_word_features.toarray(), test_char_features.toarray()])

print(f"Combined feature matrix shape: {X_train.shape[1]} features")

sgd_model = SGDClassifier(
    loss="log_loss",
    penalty="l2",
    alpha=1e-4,
    max_iter=1500,
    tol=1e-3,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
)
sgd_model.fit(X_train, train_labels)

gb_model = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=100,
    max_depth=3,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=False,
)
gb_model.fit(X_train, train_labels)

hgbc_model = HistGradientBoostingClassifier(
    max_iter=200,
    max_depth=5,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=False,
)
hgbc_model.fit(X_train, train_labels)

rf_model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=5,
    min_samples_split=5,
    min_samples_leaf=2,
    n_jobs=-1,
    random_state=42,
)
rf_model.fit(X_train, train_labels)

cal_sgd_probs = sgd_model.predict_proba(X_cal)[:, 1]
cal_gb_probs = gb_model.predict_proba(X_cal)[:, 1]
cal_hgbc_probs = hgbc_model.predict_proba(X_cal)[:, 1]
cal_rf_probs = rf_model.predict_proba(X_cal)[:, 1]
cal_base_probs = np.column_stack(
    [cal_sgd_probs, cal_gb_probs, cal_hgbc_probs, cal_rf_probs]
)

meta_model = LogisticRegression(
    penalty="l2",
    C=1.0,
    max_iter=1000,
    random_state=42,
    solver="lbfgs",
    n_jobs=-1,
)
meta_model.fit(cal_base_probs, cal_labels)

# Fit isotonic regression on CALIBRATION set (not validation)
val_sgd_probs = sgd_model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_gb_probs = gb_model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_hgbc_probs = hgbc_model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_rf_probs = rf_model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_base_probs = np.column_stack(
    [val_sgd_probs, val_gb_probs, val_hgbc_probs, val_rf_probs]
)
val_meta_probs = meta_model.predict_proba(val_base_probs)[:, 1]

cal_sgd_probs_cal = sgd_model.predict_proba(X_cal)[:, 1]
cal_gb_probs_cal = gb_model.predict_proba(X_cal)[:, 1]
cal_hgbc_probs_cal = hgbc_model.predict_proba(X_cal)[:, 1]
cal_rf_probs_cal = rf_model.predict_proba(X_cal)[:, 1]
cal_base_probs_cal = np.column_stack(
    [cal_sgd_probs_cal, cal_gb_probs_cal, cal_hgbc_probs_cal, cal_rf_probs_cal]
)
cal_meta_probs = meta_model.predict_proba(cal_base_probs_cal)[:, 1]

isotonic_reg = IsotonicRegression(out_of_bounds="clip")
isotonic_reg.fit(cal_meta_probs, cal_labels)

# Calculate held-out validation AUC on UNCALIBRATED predictions
val_auc = roc_auc_score(val_labels, val_meta_probs)
print(f"Held-out validation AUC-ROC (uncalibrated, 4-base ensemble): {val_auc:.6f}")

# Generate calibrated predictions for test set
test_sgd_probs = sgd_model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
test_gb_probs = gb_model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
test_hgbc_probs = hgbc_model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
test_rf_probs = rf_model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
test_base_probs = np.column_stack(
    [test_sgd_probs, test_gb_probs, test_hgbc_probs, test_rf_probs]
)
test_meta_probs = meta_model.predict_proba(test_base_probs)[:, 1]
test_calibrated_probs = isotonic_reg.predict(test_meta_probs)
test_calibrated_probs = np.clip(test_calibrated_probs, 0.0, 1.0)

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Comment": test_df["Comment"].values,
        "Date": test_df["Date"].values,
        "Insult": test_calibrated_probs,
    }
)
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")

print(f"\nValidation Summary:")
print(f"  Train samples: {len(train_labels)}")
print(f"  Calibration samples: {len(cal_labels)}")
print(f"  Validation samples: {len(val_labels)}")
print(f"  Calibration AUC-ROC (before calibration): {val_auc:.6f}")
print(f"  Isotonic calibration fitted on: {len(cal_labels)} calibration samples")

print("\nSubmission preview (first 5 rows):")
print(submission_df.head())
